q: We sell our metal and plastic scrap. Does that reduce our carbon footprint?
title: Selling scrap and your footprint
short: No. Selling scrap does not lower your Scope 1 or 2, and under the common cut-off approach the recycler, not you, gets the benefit of recycled material. What it does is keep scrap out of landfill, so your Category 5 waste emissions stay low.

ul: Waste to landfill falls, so Category 5 is smaller.
Revenue from scrap does not offset fuel or power.

p: You may describe the recycling separately, but avoided emissions are reported outside your inventory, never subtracted from it.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure tied to its invoice, factor and method version, so a verifier can trace any number back to the document it came from.
